title: NPTEL and Online BS courses
summary: Earning credits online: categories, CGPA effect, 36/21-credit caps, fees, transfer.

posts.md:
Apart from regular offline institute courses, **B.Tech and Dual Degree students can also take eligible online courses through NPTEL and Online BS (OB) programmes**.

These courses can help you complete credits required for your degree, subject to the applicable rules.

## NPTEL Courses

**NPTEL (National Programme on Technology Enhanced Learning)** offers online courses that B.Tech and Dual Degree students can use to earn credits towards their degree.

### Course Details

* **Mode of learning:** Online
* **Mode of exam:** Offline
* **Exam structure:** One final exam
* **Credits:** Count towards your degree
* **CGPA:** NPTEL grades **do not affect your CGPA**

**NPTEL / SWAYAM:** https://swayam.gov.in/

## Which Category Do NPTEL Credits Count Towards?

NPTEL courses can generally be transferred under the **Unallotted category**.

However, **some NPTEL courses can fulfil credits under the HS (Humanities & Sciences) category**.

>  Only NPTEL/SWAYAM courses that are **classified under the HS category on the NPTEL/SWAYAM portal** can be transferred to the **HS category** in your curriculum.

So, before registering, **check the category listed for the course on the NPTEL/SWAYAM portal**.

**Course category on NPTEL/SWAYAM → determines the curriculum category to which the credits can be transferred.**

## NPTEL Fees

* **Course learning:** Generally free
* **Certification exam:** Paid
* You need to pay an **exam registration fee** to appear for the NPTEL certification exam.
* The exam fee may vary, so check the official SWAYAM/NPTEL portal while registering.

## NPTEL Credit Transfer

After successfully passing the NPTEL certification exam:

### 1. Receive your certificate

You will receive an **NPTEL certificate** after successfully completing the certification requirements.

### 2. Raise a ticket in Workflow

After receiving the certificate, **raise a ticket in Workflow** to request the transfer of your NPTEL credits to your curriculum.

### 3. Credits are transferred

Once the process is completed, the credits will be counted towards the **applicable curriculum category**.

For example:

* **Regular NPTEL course → Unallotted**
* **NPTEL course classified as HS → HS category**

>  **Important:** Passing the NPTEL exam does not automatically transfer the credits to your curriculum. You need to raise the required ticket through Workflow after receiving your certificate.

### In short

**NPTEL Course → Final Exam → Pass → Certificate → Raise Workflow Ticket → Credits Transferred**

## Online BS (OB) Courses

B.Tech and Dual Degree students can also take eligible courses offered through the **Online BS programmes**.

These courses can count towards your **Unallotted credits**.

### Course Details

* **Mode of learning:** Online
* **Mode of exam:** Offline
* **Credits:** Count towards your degree
* **CGPA:** Grades earned in OB courses **are included in your CGPA**
* **Seat limitation:** **No seat limitations**

## Course & Exam Structure

The evaluation pattern **depends on the specific course**.

A course may include:

* Assignments
* Quizzes
* End-semester examination

However, the structure can vary between courses.

>  **Always check the specific course structure and assessment pattern before registering.**

## How to Register

There are **two ways** to take an Online BS course:

### 1. Summer Course

Register through the **SSP Portal**.

### 2. Regular Semester Course

Register through the **Course Registration Workflow**.

>  The Workflow works only in **Firefox** Browser.

Eligible BS courses will appear in the Workflow during course registration.

## Online BS Course Fees

For **B.Tech and Dual Degree students taking eligible Online BS courses through this provision, no additional fees are required**.

## Credit & Semester Limits

The following limits apply to **NPTEL + Online BS courses combined**:

* Maximum **36 credits** from NPTEL + Online BS courses combined
* Maximum **21 credits** out of those 36 can be from **NPTEL**
* Only **one course through this mode is permitted per semester**
* The credits must also remain within the overall **66-credit semester limit**

### Example

If you take a **12-credit OB course**:

**12 credits → Unallotted category**
**Grade → Included in CGPA**

If you take a **9-credit NPTEL course**:

**9 credits → Applicable category**
**Grade → Not included in CGPA**

If the NPTEL course is classified as **HS on SWAYAM**, the credits can be transferred to your **HS category**.

## Important Things to Remember

* **NPTEL + OB courses together are limited to 36 credits.**
* Maximum **21 credits** can be from NPTEL.
* Only **one NPTEL/OB course per semester** can be taken through this provision.
* The overall semester limit of **66 credits** still applies.
* **NPTEL grades do not affect CGPA.**
* **OB grades are included in CGPA.**
* Most NPTEL courses can be transferred under **Unallotted**.
* NPTEL courses classified as **HS on SWAYAM/NPTEL** can be transferred to the **HS category**.
* Always check the **NPTEL/SWAYAM course category before registering**.
* After receiving your NPTEL certificate, you must **raise a Workflow ticket for credit transfer**.
* Eligible OB courses will appear in the **Course Registration Workflow**.
* OB and NPTEL courses have **no seat limitations**.
* The list of available OB courses may change when new Online BS programmes are introduced.
* OB courses follow the programme's rules and assessment requirements strictly, so **check the course-specific details before registering**.

## In Simple Terms

### NPTEL

**Online Course**
↓
**Offline Final Exam**
↓
**Pass**
↓
**Receive Certificate**
↓
**Raise Workflow Ticket**
↓
**Credits Transferred**

**CGPA impact:**  No

**Category:** Usually **Unallotted**, but eligible courses classified as **HS on SWAYAM/NPTEL** can be transferred to **HS**.

### Online BS (OB)

**Online Course**
↓
**Course-specific Assessments**
↓
**Offline Exam**
↓
**Credits + Grade**
↓
**Counts towards your curriculum**

**CGPA impact:**  Yes

**Category:** **Unallotted**

>  **In short:**
> **NPTEL → Earn credits without affecting CGPA**
> **NPTEL (HS course) → Can fulfil HS credits**
> **Online BS → Earn credits and the grade contributes to CGPA**

## NPTEL vs Online BS (OB)

## NPTEL

**Learning:** Online
**Exam:** Offline
**Evaluation:** One final exam
**Credits:** Count towards your degree
**Category:** Usually Unallotted
**HS:** Some courses can fulfil HS credits if they are classified as **HS on NPTEL/SWAYAM**
**CGPA:**  Does not affect CGPA
**Exam fee:** Paid
**Credit transfer:** Receive certificate → Raise Workflow ticket
**Credit limit:** Maximum 21 NPTEL credits

## Online BS (OB)

**Learning:** Online
**Exam:** Offline
**Evaluation:** Depends on the course
**Credits:** Count towards your degree
**Category:** Unallotted
**CGPA:**  Grades affect CGPA
**Fee:** No additional fee for eligible on-campus students
**Seats:** No seat limitation
**Registration:** SSP for summer / Workflow for regular semester

## Common Rules

These rules apply to **NPTEL + Online BS courses combined**:

* Maximum **36 credits** combined
* Maximum **21 credits** can be from NPTEL
* Only **one course per semester** through this provision
* Credits count towards the applicable curriculum category
* Overall **66-credit semester limit** still applies

## Which One Should You Choose?

### Choose NPTEL if:

You want to **earn credits without affecting your CGPA**.

**Online → Offline final exam → Pass → Certificate → Workflow ticket → Credits**

### Choose Online BS if:

You want to **earn credits and have the course grade contribute to your CGPA**.

**Online → Course-specific assessments → Offline exam → Credits + Grade**

### Want HS Credits?

For NPTEL, **check the course category on SWAYAM/NPTEL before registering**.

Only courses classified as **HS** can be transferred to the **HS category** in your curriculum.
